Call the Cat: Galaxy is a casual action game about exploring tiny planets, painting their surfaces, and expanding your territory across the galaxy.

Travel through space with Ruru, a cat wearing a spacesuit.

Land on small planets, collect treats, paint the ground, and dodge or defeat the creatures that live there until each world belongs to the cats.

■ Explore the Galaxy

Travel through a sweet cookie universe, a freezing ice universe, a burning-hot universe, and a chaotic universe where different elements collide.

Take on small, medium, and large planets in order.

Walk, jump, throw objects, and paint each planet as you explore.

Every planet you conquer expands the cats' territory on the galaxy map.

■ Cat Headquarters

After an expedition, Ruru returns to headquarters.

Upgrade your home and spaceship before launching toward another planet.

As your headquarters grows, continue your journey farther across the galaxy.

Lie down on the bed at headquarters to enter a very different kind of adventure.

■ Dream LogNyang

Dream LogNyang is a separate survival combat mode.

Fight waves of monsters, face powerful bosses, and survive as long as you can.

Choose new ability cards during battle to grow stronger and create different combinations each run.

Ruru and Dodo have different combat styles, giving you different ways to approach the same battles.

Slimes, food monsters, elemental attacks, dangerous ground effects, and powerful bosses stand in your way.

Build your abilities and challenge higher difficulties.

■ Features

• Explore tiny planets as Ruru in a spacesuit

• Paint planetary surfaces while exploring

• Cookie, ice, fire, chaos, and other themed worlds

• Progress from small planets to larger worlds

• Upgrade your home and spaceship at Cat Headquarters

• Separate survival mode: Dream LogNyang

• Choose ability cards and grow stronger during battle

• Different combat styles for Ruru and Dodo

• Monsters, elemental hazards, ground effects, and boss battles

• Casual planet exploration and challenging survival combat

• Support for 12 languages

Suit up with Ruru and launch into space.

Start with one tiny planet and paint the galaxy in cat colors.
